note: Procedural idle motion. PLAN 8.4 lists blinking, breathing, subtle head movement, and eyebrow movement. These are emitted as normalized keyframe tracks, not as asset swaps - the library has no eye, brow, or head assets, only 12 full-face expressions. PHASE 9 binds these tracks to GSAP transforms; PHASE 8 decides only what moves and when.
deterministic_note: All jitter is derived from the source timeline's digest, so the same narration always produces the same idle motion. The image pipeline locks a seed; this is the same contract.

blink.prefer_silence_note: A blink lands more naturally in a pause than mid-syllable, so REST spans are preferred when one is near the scheduled time.
blink.render_requires: an eye region, which ASSET_SPEC does not define. See docs/animation/phase-8-lipsync-engine.md section 6 - this is a real gap in the asset spec, not an oversight here.

breath.note: A slow chest rise. Amplitude is a fraction of frame height; at 1024 this is about 15px of total travel.

head_sway.note: Two out-of-phase sines with coprime-ish periods so the motion does not visibly loop. ADR-012 keeps the head still WITHIN an asset; this moves the whole composited frame, which does not disturb the mouth anchor relative to the face.

brow.note: A brow accent on each expression change, which is where a real face punctuates. Not a continuous track.
